questions.question: What does the abbreviation 'GPT' stand for in OpenAI's chatbot assistant ChatGPT?
questions.explanation: Perfect! GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer, which is a powerful deep learning model architecture trained on massive texts to generate human-like writing.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between traditional Rule-Based Bots and Generative AI models?
options: Rule-Based bots only work on smartphones; Generative AI only works on laptops

Rule-Based bots follow strict, fixed, pre-programmed 'if' paths and cannot handle unexpected replies; Generative AI dynamically understands flexible human language intent and generates new custom answers
Generative AI cannot understand text inputs at all
Rule-Based bots learn continuously from data while Generative AI cannot learn
questions.explanation: Correct! Rule-based bots are limited by pre-defined scripts, whereas Generative AI models leverage advanced natural language patterns to generate creative, conversational answers.

questions.question: What are Large Language Models (LLMs) in artificial intelligence?
options: Large screens used to display text coding scripts
Smart neural networks trained on huge text datasets to understand, generate, and translate human-like writing
Special databases that only record phone numbers
Traditional bots that can only output fixed error messages
questions.explanation: Great! Large Language Models are advanced deep learning neural networks capable of performing an extremely wide range of natural language processing tasks.
